name: Cosmos
author: DesTicY
description: Go under the UFO portal as the wave at 47%. Navigate through the following gameplay as the wave while avoiding all the portals until 57% where you can fall to the floor between the saws. Avoid the obstacles on the floor while staying semi-near/on the floor until 73% where you can go above the wave and 3x speed portal and play the section at a slower speed instead. At 79%, you will enter a ship portal. Play the level normally from there.
